talents.site_en: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 1%.

talents.site_en: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your abilities by 10%.

talents.name: Sweeping Strikes

talents.site_en: Your next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent.

talents.name: Improved Slam

talents.site_en: Gives your Hamstring ability a 5% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

talents.site_en: A vicious strike that deals weapon damage plus 85 and wounds the target, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 10 sec.

talents.site_en: Causes all enemies within 10 yds to be Dazed, reducing movement speed by 50% for 6 sec.

talents.name: Deadly Aspects
talents.game_en: While Aspect of the Hawk is active, Auto Shot has a 10% chance of increasing ranged attack speed by 30% for 12 sec. While Aspect of the Beast is active, all melee auto attacks have a 10% chance of increasing melee attack speed by 30% for 12 sec.
talents.site_en: While Aspect of the Hawk is active, Auto Shot has a 2% chance of increasing ranged attack speed by 30% for 12 sec. While Aspect of the Beast is active, all melee auto attacks have a 2% chance of increasing melee attack speed by 30% for 12 sec.

talents.name: Endurance Training
talents.game_en: Increases the Health and Armor of your pets by 15%.
talents.site_en: Increases the Health and Armor of your pets by 3%.

talents.name: Focused Fire
talents.game_en: Increases all damage you and your pet deal by 2% while your pet is active.
talents.site_en: Increases all damage you and your pet deal by 1% while your pet is active.

talents.name: Improved Aspect of the Monkey
talents.game_en: Increases the Dodge bonus of your Aspect of the Monkey by 4%. Additionally, your pet gains 50% of the effect of your Aspect of the Monkey ability.
talents.site_en: Increases the Dodge bonus of your Aspect of the Monkey by 2%. Additionally, your pet gains 50% of the effect of your Aspect of the Monkey ability.

talents.name: Improved Revive Pet
talents.game_en: Revive Pet's casting time is reduced by 6 sec, mana cost is reduced by 40%, and increases the health your pet returns with by an additional 30%.
talents.site_en: Revive Pet's casting time is reduced by 3 sec, mana cost is reduced by 20%, and increases the health your pet returns with by an additional 15%.

talents.name: Pathfinding
talents.game_en: Increases the speed bonus of your Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack by 6%.
talents.site_en: Increases the speed bonus of your Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack by 3%.

talents.name: Bestial Swiftness
talents.game_en: Increases the movement speed of your pets by 30%.
talents.site_en: Increases the movement speed of your pets by 30%.

talents.name: Unleashed Fury
talents.game_en: Increases the damage done by your pets and hawks by 20%.
talents.site_en: Increases the damage done by your pets and hawks by 3%.

talents.name: Improved Mend Pet
talents.game_en: Gives your Mend Pet spell a 50% chance of cleansing 1 Curse, Disease, Magic, or Poison effect from your pet each time it heals and reduces the Mana cost by 20%.
talents.site_en: Gives your Mend Pet spell a 15% chance of cleansing 1 Curse, Disease, Magic, or Poison effect from your pet each time it heals and reduces the Mana cost by 10%.

talents.name: Ferocity
talents.game_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your pets and hawks by 16%.
talents.site_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your pets and hawks by 2%.

talents.name: Summon Hawk
talents.game_en: Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing ${$s1+($rap*($s4/100))} Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec. Only 2 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.
talents.site_en: Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing 34 Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec. Only 2 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.

talents.name: Spirit Bond
talents.game_en: While your pet is active, you and your pet will regenerate 1% of total health every 5 sec.
talents.site_en: While your pet is active, you and your pet will regenerate 1% of total health every 10 sec.

talents.name: Intimidation
talents.game_en: Command your pet to Stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.
talents.site_en: Command your pet to Stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.

talents.name: Bestial Discipline
talents.game_en: Increases the Focus regeneration of your pets by 100% and allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.
talents.site_en: Increases the Focus regeneration of your pets by 10% and allows 25% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.name: Frenzy
talents.game_en: Gives your pet a 20% chance to gain a 30% attack speed increase for 8 sec after dealing a critical strike.
talents.site_en: Gives your pet a 20% chance to gain a 30% attack speed increase for 8 sec after dealing a critical strike.

talents.name: Bestial Wrath
talents.game_en: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.
talents.site_en: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.

talents.name: Hawk Eye
talents.game_en: Increases the range of your ranged weapons by 6 yards.
talents.site_en: Increases the range of your ranged weapons by 2 yards.

talents.name: Improved Concussive Shot
talents.game_en: Gives your Concussive Shot a $m1% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.
talents.site_en: Gives your Concussive Shot a 4% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

talents.name: Lethal Attacks
talents.game_en: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by 1%.
talents.site_en: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by 1%.

talents.name: Improved Stings
talents.game_en: Increases the damage of your Serpent Sting ability by 20%, reduces the cooldown of your Viper Sting ability by 6 sec, and increases the duration of your Scorpid Sting ability by 45 sec.
talents.site_en: Increases the damage of your Serpent Sting ability by 6%, reduces the cooldown of your Viper Sting ability by 2 sec, and increases the duration of your Scorpid Sting ability by 15 sec.

talents.name: Efficiency
talents.game_en: Reduces the Mana cost of your Shots, Stings, and melee abilities by 15%.
talents.site_en: Reduces the Mana cost of your Shots, Stings, and melee abilities by 3%.

talents.name: Careful Aim
talents.game_en: Increases your Attack Power by 100% of your Intellect.
talents.site_en: Increases your Attack Power by 20% of your Intellect.

talents.name: Rapid Killing
talents.game_en: Reduces the cooldown on your Rapid Fire ability by 2 min. In addition, when you kill a non-trivial enemy or it dies while afflicted by your Serpent Sting, you gain Rapid Killing, increasing the damage of your next Shot ability within 20 sec by 20%.
talents.site_en: Reduces the cooldown on your Rapid Fire ability by 1 min. In addition, when you kill a non-trivial enemy or it dies while afflicted by your Serpent Sting, you gain Rapid Killing, increasing the damage of your next Shot ability within 20 sec by 10%.

talents.name: Improved Arcane Shot
talents.game_en: Reduces the cooldown of your Arcane Shot by 1.5 sec. Does not affect the cooldown of abilities which share a cooldown with Arcane Shot.
talents.site_en: Reduces the cooldown of your Arcane Shot by 0.3 sec. Does not affect the cooldown of abilities which share a cooldown with Arcane Shot.

talents.name: Lone Wolf
talents.game_en: You deal 20% increased damage with all attacks while you do not have an active pet.
talents.site_en: You deal 20% increased damage with all attacks while you do not have an active pet.

talents.name: Trueshot Aura
talents.game_en: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party or raid members within 45 yds by 20.
talents.site_en: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party or raid members within 45 yds by 20.

talents.name: Mortal Shots
talents.game_en: Increases the critical strike damage bonus on all ranged abilities by 30%.
talents.site_en: Increases the critical strike damage bonus on all ranged abilities by 6%.

talents.name: Rapid Recuperation
talents.game_en: Afflicting a target with Serpent Sting allows 50% of your Mana Regeneration to continue while casting for 15 sec, increased to 100% when Rapid Killing is consumed.
talents.site_en: Afflicting a target with Serpent Sting allows 25% of your Mana Regeneration to continue while casting for 15 sec, increased to 50% when Rapid Killing is consumed.

talents.name: Barrage
talents.game_en: Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by 15%.
talents.site_en: Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by 5%.

talents.name: Scatter Shot
talents.game_en: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.
talents.site_en: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.

talents.name: Ranged Weapon Specialization
talents.game_en: Increases the damage you deal with ranged weapons by 5%.
talents.site_en: Increases the damage you deal with ranged weapons by 1%.

talents.name: Sniper Shot
talents.game_en: A long-range shot that deals ranged damage plus 320 and increases the range of your next 3 Shots by 10 yards for 10 sec.
talents.site_en: A long-range shot that deals ranged damage plus 320 and increases the range of your next 3 Shots by 10 yards for 10 sec.

talents.name: Improved Serpent Sting
talents.game_en: Increases the damage done by your Serpent Sting by 10%.

talents.name: Improved Tracking
talents.game_en: While tracking Beasts, Demons, Dragonkin, Elementals, Giants, Humanoids, or Undead, all damage you deal to the tracked creature type is increased by 5%.
talents.site_en: While tracking Beasts, Demons, Dragonkin, Elementals, Giants, Humanoids, or Undead, all damage you deal to the tracked creature type is increased by 1%.

talents.name: Deflection
talents.game_en: Increases your Parry chance by 5%.
talents.site_en: Increases your Parry chance by 1%.

talents.name: Entrapment
talents.game_en: When your traps are triggered, all affected targets are Entrapped, preventing them from moving for 5 sec.
talents.site_en: When your traps are triggered, all affected targets are Entrapped, preventing them from moving for 1 sec.

talents.name: Savage Strikes
talents.game_en: Increases the critical strike chance of all your melee abilities by 20%.
talents.site_en: Increases the critical strike chance of all your melee abilities by 2%.

talents.name: Survivalist
talents.game_en: Increases your total Health by 10%.
talents.site_en: Increases your total Health by 2%.

talents.name: Improved Wing Clip
talents.game_en: Gives your Wing Clip ability a 20% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.
talents.site_en: Gives your Wing Clip ability a 7% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

talents.name: Clever Traps
talents.game_en: Increases the duration of Freezing and Frost trap effects by 30% and the damage of Immolation and Explosive trap effects by 30%.
talents.site_en: Increases the duration of Freezing and Frost trap effects by 15% and the damage of Immolation and Explosive trap effects by 15%.

talents.name: Surefooted
talents.game_en: Increases your hit chance by 3% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects on you by 30%.
talents.site_en: Increases your hit chance by 1% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects on you by 10%.

talents.name: Deterrence
talents.game_en: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.
talents.site_en: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.

talents.name: Survival Tactics
talents.game_en: Increases your chance to hit with your Trap and Feign Death abilities by 17%.
talents.site_en: Increases your chance to hit with your Trap and Feign Death abilities by 5%.

talents.name: Predator's Edge
talents.game_en: Increases your melee ability critical strike damage by 30% and your Off Hand weapon damage by 50%.
talents.site_en: Increases your melee ability critical strike damage by 6% and your Off Hand weapon damage by 10%.

talents.name: Counterattack
talents.game_en: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 26 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.
talents.site_en: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 26 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

talents.name: Resourcefulness
talents.game_en: Reduces the Mana cost of your Trap and melee abilities by 60%, and grants your melee and ranged ability Critical Strikes a 100% chance to allow 50% of your Mana Regeneration to continue while casting for 30 sec.
talents.site_en: Reduces the Mana cost of your Trap and melee abilities by 30%, and grants your melee and ranged ability Critical Strikes a 50% chance to allow 50% of your Mana Regeneration to continue while casting for 30 sec.

talents.name: Expose Prey
talents.game_en: Grants your melee and ranged attacks against enemies afflicted by Hunter's Mark a 10% chance to allow an activation of Mongoose Bite. Lasts 10 sec.
talents.site_en: Grants your melee and ranged attacks against enemies afflicted by Hunter's Mark a 5% chance to allow an activation of Mongoose Bite. Lasts 10 sec.

talents.name: Survivalist's Discipline
talents.game_en: Reduces the cooldown of your Trap and Deterrence abilities by 40%.
talents.site_en: Reduces the cooldown of your Trap and Deterrence abilities by 20%.

talents.name: Strider Kick
talents.game_en: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec.
talents.site_en: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec.

talents.name: Lightning Reflexes
talents.game_en: Increases your Agility by 15%.
talents.site_en: Increases your Agility by 3%.

talents.name: Lacerating Strikes
talents.game_en: Your Mongoose Bite also causes the target to Bleed for damage equal to 40% of the damage done by Mongoose Bite over 21 sec
talents.site_en: Your Mongoose Bite also causes the target to Bleed for damage equal to 40% of the damage done by Mongoose Bite over 21 sec

talents.name: Lightning Reflexes
talents.game_en: Increases your Agility by 15%.

talents.name: Improved Gouge
talents.game_en: Increases the duration of your Gouge ability by 1.5 sec.
talents.site_en: Increases the duration of your Gouge ability by 0.5 sec.

talents.name: Remorseless Attacks
talents.game_en: After killing a non-trivial enemy, gives you a $m1% increased critical strike chance on your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Mutilate, or Ghostly Strike. Lasts 20 sec.
talents.site_en: After killing a non-trivial enemy, gives you a 20% increased critical strike chance on your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Mutilate, or Ghostly Strike. Lasts 20 sec.

talents.name: Malice
talents.game_en: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by 5%.
talents.site_en: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by 1%.

talents.name: Ruthlessness
talents.game_en: Gives your finishing moves a 60% chance to add a Combo Point to your target.
talents.site_en: Gives your finishing moves a 20% chance to add a Combo Point to your target.

talents.name: Improved Expose Armor
talents.game_en: Reduces the Energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by 10, and refunds 2 Combo Points when cast with 5 Combo Points.
talents.site_en: Reduces the Energy cost of your Expose Armor ability by 5, and refunds 1 Combo Points when cast with 5 Combo Points.

talents.name: Improved Slice and Dice
talents.game_en: Increases the duration of your Slice and Dice ability by 15%.
talents.site_en: Increases the duration of your Slice and Dice ability by 15%.

talents.name: Vigor
talents.game_en: Increases your maximum Energy by 10.
talents.site_en: Increases your maximum Energy by 5.

talents.name: Blood Splatter
talents.game_en: Increases the duration of your Rupture ability by 4 sec and your Garrote ability by 6 sec.

talents.name: Lethality
talents.game_en: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by 6%.
talents.site_en: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by 4%.

talents.name: Vile Poisons
talents.game_en: Increases the damage dealt by your poisons by 20% and gives your poisons an additional 40% chance to resist dispel effects.
talents.site_en: Increases the damage dealt by your poisons by 4% and gives your poisons an additional 8% chance to resist dispel effects.

talents.name: Cold Blood
talents.game_en: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%.
talents.site_en: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%.

talents.name: Improved Poisons
talents.game_en: Increases the chance to apply Poisons to your target by 10%, and gives Poison applications a 50% chance to not consume a charge.
talents.site_en: Increases the chance to apply Poisons to your target by 2%, and gives Poison applications a 10% chance to not consume a charge.

talents.name: Relentless Strikes
talents.game_en: Your finishing moves have a $m1% chance per Combo Point to restore 25 Energy.
talents.site_en: Your finishing moves have a 20% chance per Combo Point to restore 25 Energy.

talents.name: Venom
talents.game_en: Causes your Shank ability to increase your Poison damage by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 20% for 6 sec.
talents.site_en:
Finishing move that increases the damage of your Poisons by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 10%. Lasts longer per combo point:
1 point : 9 sec
2 points: 12 sec
3 points: 15 sec
4 points: 18 sec
5 points: 21 sec

talents.name: Improved Kidney Shot
talents.game_en: Enemies Stunned by your Kidney Shot ability take 10% increased damage from your poisons and attacks.
talents.site_en: Enemies Stunned by your Kidney Shot ability take 5% increased damage from your poisons and attacks.

talents.name: Seal Fate
talents.game_en: Your critical strikes from abilities that add Combo Points have a 0% chance to add an additional Combo Point.
talents.site_en: Your critical strikes from abilities that add Combo Points have a 20% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

talents.name: Mutilate
talents.game_en: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 90% weapon damage plus an additional 39.6 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points.
talents.site_en: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 75% weapon damage plus an additional 17 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points.

talents.name: Coup de Grace
talents.game_en: Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 20%, and the damage and storage rate of your Death Mark ability by 20%.
talents.site_en: Increases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 7%.

talents.name: Efficient Strikes
talents.game_en: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike and Hemorrhage abilities by 5.
talents.site_en: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sinister Strike and Hemorrhage abilities by 3.

talents.name: Lightning Reflexes
talents.game_en: Increases your Dodge chance by 5%.
talents.site_en: Increases your Dodge chance by 1%.

talents.name: Puncturing Wounds
talents.game_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by 30% and your Mutilate by 15%, and gives Backstab a 45% chance to add an additional Combo Point.
talents.site_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by 10% and your Mutilate by 5%, and gives Backstab a 15% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

talents.name: Deflection
talents.game_en: Increases your Parry chance by 1%.
talents.site_en: Increases your Parry chance by 2%.

talents.name: Precision
talents.game_en: Improves your chance to hit by 1%.
talents.site_en: Improves your chance to hit by 1%.

talents.name: Improved Sprint
talents.game_en: Gives a 100% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.
talents.site_en: Gives a 50% chance to remove all movement impairing effects when you activate your Sprint ability.

talents.name: Endurance
talents.game_en: Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by 60%.
talents.site_en: Reduces the cooldown of your Sprint and Evasion abilities by 30%.

talents.name: Riposte
talents.game_en: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for $19718d.
talents.site_en: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for 6 sec.

talents.name: Composure
talents.game_en: Increases the Energy cost reduction of your Poised ability by $s1.

talents.name: Improved Kick
talents.game_en: Gives your Kick ability a 100% chance to Silence the target for 2 sec.
talents.site_en: Gives your Kick ability a 50% chance to Silence the target for 2 sec.

talents.name: Flawless Execution
talents.game_en: Reduces the Energy cost of your Eviscerate ability by 15.
talents.site_en: Reduces the Energy cost of your Eviscerate ability by 15.

talents.name: Weapon Expertise
talents.game_en: Reduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 2%.
talents.site_en: Reduces the chance for your attacks to be Dodged or Parried by 1%.

talents.name: Aggression
talents.game_en: Increases the damage of your Sinister Strike and Eviscerate abilities by 2%.
talents.site_en: Increases the damage of your Sinister Strike and Eviscerate abilities by 2%.

talents.name: Dual Wield Specialization
talents.game_en: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 50%.
talents.site_en: Increases the damage done by your off-hand weapon by 5%.

talents.name: Blade Flurry
talents.game_en: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.
talents.site_en: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.

talents.name: Hack and Slash
talents.game_en:
Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon.

 |CFFFFFFFFAxe/Sword:|R Your successful
 melee attacks have a 5% chance
 to trigger an extra attack on the 
 target.

 |CFFFFFFFFDagger/Fist:|R Increases your
 critical strike chance by 5%.

 |CFFFFFFFFMace:|R Your attacks ignore 15% of
 your target's armor.
talents.site_en:
Gives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon.

 Axe/Sword: Your successful
 melee attacks have a 1% chance
 to trigger an extra attack on the 
 target.

 Dagger/Fist: Increases your
 critical strike chance by 1%.

 Mace: Your attacks ignore 3% of
 your target's armor.

talents.name: Flash of Steel
talents.game_en: Increases the Energy generated by your Shank ability by 15 and reduces its cooldown by 2.5 sec.

talents.name: Adrenaline Rush
talents.game_en: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.
talents.site_en: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.

talents.name: Setup
talents.game_en: Gives you a $m1% chance to add a Combo Point to your target after Dodging their attack or fully resisting one of their spells.
talents.site_en: Gives you a 33% chance to add a Combo Point to your target after Dodging one of their attacks or fully resisting one of their spells.

talents.name: Master of Deception
talents.game_en: Reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while in Stealth mode as if you were 3 levels higher.
talents.site_en: Reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while in Stealth mode as if you were 1 levels higher.

talents.name: Opportunity
talents.game_en: Increases the damage dealt by your Backstab, Garrote, Ambush, and Mutilate abilities by 10%.
talents.site_en: Increases the damage dealt by your Backstab, Garrote, Ambush, and Mutilate abilities by 5%.

talents.name: Dirty Deeds
talents.game_en: Reduces the Energy cost of your Cheap Shot and Garrote abilities by 20, and your Garrote ability no longer requires you to be behind your target.
talents.site_en: Reduces the Energy cost of your Cheap Shot and Garrote abilities by 10, and your Garrote ability no longer requires you to be behind your target.

talents.name: Camouflage
talents.game_en: Reduces your speed penalty from your Stealth ability by 15% and reduces its cooldown by 6 sec.
talents.site_en: Reduces your speed penalty from your Stealth ability by 3% and reduces its cooldown by 2 sec.

talents.name: Improved Ambush
talents.game_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 45%.
talents.site_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your Ambush ability by 15%.

talents.name: Dirty Tricks
talents.game_en: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sap and Blind abilities by 50%.
talents.site_en: Reduces the Energy cost of your Sap and Blind abilities by 25%.

talents.name: Initiative
talents.game_en: Gives you a 100% chance to add an additional combo point to your target when using your Ambush, Garrote, or Cheap Shot ability.
talents.site_en: Gives you a 33% chance to add an additional combo point to your target when using your Ambush, Garrote, or Cheap Shot ability.

talents.name: Premeditation
talents.game_en: Adds 2 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.
talents.site_en: Adds 2 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.

talents.name: Serrated Blades
talents.game_en: Causes your attacks to ignore 9% of your target's Armor and increases the damage dealt by your Rupture ability by 30%.
talents.site_en: Causes your attacks to ignore 3% of your target's Armor and increases the damage dealt by your Rupture ability by 10%.

talents.name: Elusiveness
talents.game_en: Reduces the cooldown of your Vanish and Blind abilities by 90 sec.
talents.site_en: Reduces the cooldown of your Vanish and Blind abilities by 45 sec.

talents.name: Ghostly Strike
talents.game_en: A strike that deals 125% (180% if a Dagger is equipped in your Main Hand) weapon damage, increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec, and causes your next Ambush or Garrote cast within 7 sec to not require Stealth. Awards 1 combo point.
talents.site_en: A strike that deals 125% (180% if a Dagger is equipped in your Main Hand) weapon damage and increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec. Awards 1 combo points.

talents.name: Quick Getaway
talents.game_en: Increases the maximum number of targets you may have Sapped by 1, and increases your movement speed by 35% for 3 sec after Sapping a target.

talents.name: Heightened Senses
talents.game_en: Increases your Stealth detection as if you were 3 levels higher and reduces your chance to be hit by spells and ranged attacks by 6%.
talents.site_en: Increases your Stealth detection as if you were 1 levels higher and reduces your chance to be hit by spells and ranged attacks by 2%.

talents.name: Preparation
talents.game_en: When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities.
talents.site_en: When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities.

talents.name: Hemorrhage
talents.game_en: An instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage (145% if a Dagger is equipped) and causes the target to take 15% increased Rupture and Garrote damage from the Rogue. Lasts 15 sec. Awards 1 Combo Point.
talents.site_en: An instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage (145% if a Dagger is equipped) and causes the target to take 15% increased Rupture and Garrote damage from the Rogue. Lasts 15 sec. Awards 1 Combo Point.

talents.name: Boot Knife
talents.game_en: Grants your Shank ability a 100% chance to add 2 Combo Points to the target.

talents.name: Death Mark
talents.game_en:
Finishing move that marks the target, storing a portion of the damage dealt by your attacks per Combo Point. Garrote and Rupture damage is stored at twice the rate. After 6 sec, the stored damage is dealt, up to a maximum increased by Attack Power and Critical Strike chance:
 1 point : ${1*$<ratio>}% stored, ${((63+(1*102)+1*$<maxAP>*$apm)*($mcrit/100+1))*$<coup>} damage cap
 2 points: ${2*$<ratio>}% stored, ${((63+(2*102)+2*$<maxAP>*$apm)*($mcrit/100+1))*$<coup>} damage cap
 3 points: ${3*$<ratio>}% stored, ${((63+(3*102)+3*$<maxAP>*$apm)*($mcrit/100+1))*$<coup>} damage cap
 4 points: ${4*$<ratio>}% stored, ${((63+(4*102)+4*$<maxAP>*$apm)*($mcrit/100+1))*$<coup>} damage cap
 5 points: ${5*$<ratio>}% stored, ${((63+(5*102)+5*$<maxAP>*$apm)*($mcrit/100+1))*$<coup>} damage cap

talents.name: Power in Light
talents.game_en: Your Smite and Penance spells deal 15% increased damage to targets afflicted with your Holy Fire or Shadow Word: Pain.
talents.site_en: Your Smite and Penance spells deal 2% increased damage to targets afflicted with your Holy Fire or Shadow Word: Pain.

talents.name: Wand Specialization
talents.game_en: Increases your damage with Wands by 25%.
talents.site_en: Increases your damage with Wands by 13%.

talents.name: Twin Disciplines
talents.game_en: Increases the damage and healing of your instant cast spells by 5%.
talents.site_en: Increases the damage and healing of your instant cast spells by 1%.

talents.name: Silent Resolve
talents.game_en: Reduces the threat generated by your spells by 30% and reduces the duration of Stun, Fear, and Silence effects inflicted on you by 15%.
talents.site_en: Reduces the threat generated by your spells by 10% and reduces the duration of Stun, Fear, and Silence effects inflicted on you by 5%.

talents.name: Holy Precision
talents.game_en: Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 18%.
talents.site_en: Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by 6%.

talents.name: Mental Strength
talents.game_en: Increases your total Intellect by 15%.
talents.site_en: Increases your total Intellect by 2%.

talents.name: Martyrdom
talents.game_en: Gives you a $m1% chance to gain Focused Casting for 6 sec after being the victim of a melee or ranged critical strike. The Focused Casting effect prevents you from losing casting time when taking damage and increases your resistance to Interrupt effects by 20%.
talents.site_en: Gives you a 50% chance to gain Focused Casting for 6 sec after being the victim of a melee or ranged critical strike. The Focused Casting effect prevents you from losing casting time when taking damage and increases your resistance to Interrupt effects by 20%.

talents.name: Mental Agility
talents.game_en: Reduces the mana cost of your Smite, Holy Fire, and instant cast spells by 10%.
talents.site_en: Reduces the mana cost of your Smite, Holy Fire, and instant cast spells by 3%.

talents.name: Inner Focus
talents.game_en: When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is a non-periodic spell and capable of a critical effect.
talents.site_en: When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is a non-periodic spell and capable of a critical effect.

talents.name: Improved Power Word: Shield
talents.game_en: Increases the damage absorbed by your Power Word: Shield by 20%.
talents.site_en: Increases the damage absorbed by your Power Word: Shield by 7%.

talents.name: Meditation
talents.game_en: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.
talents.site_en: Allows 17% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.name: Improved Inner Fire
talents.game_en: Increases the Armor bonus of your Inner Fire spell by 45% and increases its total charges by 12.
talents.site_en: Increases the Armor bonus of your Inner Fire spell by 15% and increases its total charges by 4.

talents.name: Improved Mana Burn
talents.game_en: Reduces the casting time of your Mana Burn spell by 1 sec.
talents.site_en: Reduces the casting time of your Mana Burn spell by 0.5 sec.

talents.name: Soul Warding
talents.game_en: Reduces the cooldown on your Power Word: Shield spell by 4 sec and reduces its mana cost by 15%.
talents.site_en: Reduces the cooldown on your Power Word: Shield spell by 4 sec and reduces its mana cost by 15%.

talents.name: Penance
talents.game_en: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 45 Holy damage to an enemy, or 134 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.
talents.site_en: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing 45 Holy damage to an enemy, or 134 healing to an ally, instantly and every 1 sec for 2 sec.

talents.name: Renewed Hope
talents.game_en: Your heals from Flash Heal, Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, and Penance gain 10% increased critical strike chance when cast on targets with Weakened Soul, and reduce the remaining duration of Weakened Soul on their target by 5 sec.
talents.site_en: Your heals from Flash Heal, Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, and Penance gain 2% increased critical strike chance when cast on targets with Weakened Soul, and reduce the remaining duration of Weakened Soul on their target by 1 sec.

talents.name: Divine Aegis
talents.game_en: Your non-periodic critical heals create a protective shield on the target, absorbing 15% of the amount healed. Shields up to ${$s2*$pl} damage and lasts 12 sec.
talents.site_en: Your non-periodic critical heals create a protective shield on the target, absorbing 5% of the amount healed. Shields up to 1200 damage and lasts 12 sec.

talents.name: Power Infusion
talents.game_en: Infuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing done by 20% for 15 sec.
talents.site_en: Infuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing done by 20% for 15 sec.

talents.name: Twilight Focus
talents.game_en: Gives your spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.
talents.site_en: Gives your spells a 23% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

talents.name: Improved Renew
talents.game_en: Increases the amount healed by your Renew spell by 5%.
talents.site_en: Increases the amount healed by your Renew spell by 5%.

talents.name: Holy Specialization
talents.game_en: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by 1%.
talents.site_en: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by 1%.

talents.name: Spell Warding
talents.game_en: Reduces all spell damage taken by 10%.
talents.site_en: Reduces all spell damage taken by 2%.

talents.name: Divine Fury
talents.game_en: Reduces the casting time of your Smite, Holy Fire, Heal, and Greater Heal spells by 0.5 sec.
talents.site_en: Reduces the casting time of your Smite, Holy Fire, Heal, and Greater Heal spells by 0.1 sec.

talents.name: Holy Nova
talents.game_en: Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster, causing 26 to 30 Holy damage to all enemy targets within 10 yards and healing all party members within 10 yards for 50 to 57. These effects cause no threat.
talents.site_en: Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster, causing 26 to 30 Holy damage to all enemy targets within 10 yards and healing all party members within 10 yards for 50 to 57. These effects cause no threat.

talents.name: Blessed Recovery
talents.game_en: After being struck by a melee or ranged critical hit, or suffering more than 30% of your maximum Health from a single attack, heal 8% of the damage taken over 6 sec. Refreshing this effect carries over any remaining healing.
talents.site_en: After being struck by a melee or ranged critical hit, or suffering more than 30% of your maximum Health from a single attack, heal 8% of the damage taken over 6 sec. Refreshing this effect carries over any remaining healing.

talents.name: Inspiration
talents.game_en: Your non-periodic critical heals increase your target's Armor by $m1% for 15 sec.
talents.site_en: Your non-periodic critical heals increase your target's Armor by 8% for 15 sec.

talents.name: Holy Reach
talents.game_en: Increases the range of your Smite and Holy Fire spells and the radius of your Prayer of Healing and Holy Nova spells by 10%.
talents.site_en: Increases the range of your Smite and Holy Fire spells and the radius of your Prayer of Healing and Holy Nova spells by 10%.

talents.name: Improved Healing
talents.game_en: Reduces the Mana cost of your Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, Penance, and Prayer of Mending spells by 15%.
talents.site_en: Reduces the Mana cost of your Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, Penance, and Prayer of Mending spells by 5%.

talents.name: Searing Light
talents.game_en: Increases your Holy damage done by 10%, and gives a 10% chance each time your Holy Fire spell deals periodic damage for your next Holy Nova to cost no Mana.
talents.site_en: Increases your Holy damage done by 2%, and gives a 5% chance each time your Holy Fire spell deals periodic damage for your next Holy Nova to cost no Mana.

talents.name: Holy Binding
talents.game_en: Each time you heal a target other than yourself with Flash Heal, you are healed for 50% as much. This healing generates no threat.
talents.site_en: Each time you heal a target other than yourself with Flash Heal, you are healed for 50% as much. This healing generates no threat.

talents.name: Litany of Light
talents.game_en: When you cast a healing spell, gain Mana equal to 20% of the base cost of the spell if your previous heal was a different spell.
talents.site_en: When you cast a healing spell, gain Mana equal to 5% of the base cost of the spell if your previous heal was a different spell.

talents.name: Spirit of Redemption
talents.game_en: Upon death, the priest becomes the Spirit of Redemption for 15 sec. The Spirit of Redemption cannot move, attack, be attacked or targeted by any spells or effects. While in this form the priest can cast any healing spell free of cost. When the effect ends, the priest dies.
talents.site_en: Upon death, the priest becomes the Spirit of Redemption for 15 sec. The Spirit of Redemption cannot move, attack, be attacked or targeted by any spells or effects. While in this form the priest can cast any healing spell free of cost. When the effect ends, the priest dies.

talents.name: Spiritual Guidance
talents.game_en: Increases your spell healing by up to 25% of your total Spirit and your spell damage by up to 8% of your total Spirit.
talents.site_en: Increases your spell healing by up to 5% of your total Spirit and your spell damage by up to 1% of your total Spirit.

talents.name: Spiritual Healing
talents.game_en: Increases the amount healed by your spells by 2%.
talents.site_en: Increases the amount healed by your spells by 3%.

talents.name: Prayer of Mending
talents.game_en: Places a spell on the target that heals them for ${($m1+($bh*$bc))*$<mult>} the next time they take damage or receive non-periodic healing. When the heal occurs, Prayer of Mending jumps to a party or raid member within 20 yards. Jumps up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec after each jump. This spell can only be placed on one target at a time per caster.
talents.site_en: Places a spell on the target that heals them for 172 the next time they take damage or receive non-periodic healing. When the heal occurs, Prayer of Mending jumps to a party or raid member within 20 yards. Jumps up to 5 times and lasts 30 sec after each jump. This spell can only be placed on one target at a time per caster.

talents.name: Shadow Focus
talents.game_en: Improves your chance to hit with Shadow spells by 5%.
talents.site_en: Improves your chance to hit with Shadow spells by 1%.

talents.name: Blackout
talents.game_en: Gives your Shadow damage spells a 10% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.
talents.site_en: Gives your Shadow damage spells a 2% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

talents.name: Spirit Tap
talents.game_en: Gives you a $m1% chance to increase your Spirit by 100% for 15 sec after killing a non-trivial target or when an enemy afflicted by your Vampiric Embrace dies. For the duration, 50% of your Mana regeneration will continue while casting.
talents.site_en: Gives you a 20% chance to increase your Spirit by 100% for 15 sec after killing a non-trivial target or when an enemy afflicted by your Vampiric Embrace dies. For the duration, 50% of your Mana regeneration will continue while casting.

talents.name: Improved Mind Blast
talents.game_en: Reduces the cooldown of your Mind Blast spell by 2.5 sec.
talents.site_en: Reduces the cooldown of your Mind Blast spell by 0.5 sec.

talents.name: Improved Shadow Word: Pain
talents.game_en: Increases the duration of your Shadow Word: Pain spell by 6 sec.
talents.site_en: Increases the duration of your Shadow Word: Pain spell by 3 sec.

talents.name: Shadow Reach
talents.game_en: Increases the range of your offensive Shadow spells by 20%.
talents.site_en: Increases the range of your offensive Shadow spells by 10%.

talents.name: Improved Psychic Scream
talents.game_en: Reduces the cooldown of your Psychic Scream spell by 4 sec.
talents.site_en: Reduces the cooldown of your Psychic Scream spell by 2 sec.

talents.name: Mind Flay
talents.game_en: Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 63 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.
talents.site_en: Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 63 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.

talents.name: Improved Mind Flay
talents.game_en: Each instance of damage of Mind Flay deals 20% more damage than its previous instance of damage.
talents.site_en: Each instance of damage of Mind Flay deals 10% more damage than its previous instance of damage.

talents.name: Dark Inspiration
talents.game_en: Your Mind Blast and fully channeled Mind Flay causes Dark Inspiration, increasing yours and your party's Spirit by 15% for 10 sec.
talents.site_en: Your Mind Blast and fully channeled Mind Flay causes Dark Inspiration, increasing yours and your party's Spirit by 3% for 10 sec.

talents.name: Vampiric Embrace
talents.game_en: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec.
talents.site_en: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec.

talents.name: Shadow Weaving
talents.game_en: Your Shadow damage spells have a 100% chance to increase the Shadow damage the target takes from you by 2% for 15 sec, stacking up to 5 times.
talents.site_en: Your Shadow damage spells have a 33% chance to increase the Shadow damage the target takes from you by 2% for 15 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

talents.name: Silence
talents.game_en: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec and interrupting their spellcasts for 3 sec.
talents.site_en: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec and interrupting their spellcasts for 3 sec.

talents.name: Devouring Contagion
talents.game_en:
Reduces the mana cost of your Devouring Plague by 50%.

Targets that die while Devouring Plague is active spreads it, jumping to 2 nearby enemies within 10 yds for the remaining duration.
talents.site_en:
Reduces the mana cost of your Devouring Plague by 25%.

Targets that die while Devouring Plague is active spreads it, jumping to 2 nearby enemies within 5 yds for the remaining duration.

talents.name: Early Demise
talents.game_en: Increases Shadow Word: Death's critical strike chance on targets at or below 20% health by 30%.
talents.site_en: Increases Shadow Word: Death's critical strike chance on targets at or below 20% health by 15%.

talents.name: Darkness
talents.game_en: Increases your Shadow damage done by 10%.
talents.site_en: Increases your Shadow damage done by 2%.

talents.name: Shadowform
talents.game_en: Assume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form.
talents.site_en: Assume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form.

talents.name: Holy Specialization
talents.game_en: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by 1%.

talents.name: Convection
talents.game_en: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock, Lightning Bolt, and Chain Lightning spells by 2%.
talents.site_en: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock, Lightning Bolt, and Chain Lightning spells by 2%.

talents.name: Concussion
talents.game_en: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Earth Shock spells by 1%.
talents.site_en: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Earth Shock spells by 1%.

talents.name: Elemental Devastation
talents.game_en: Your Critical Strikes with direct damage spells increase your chance to get a Critical Strike with melee attacks by $m1% for 10 sec.
talents.site_en: Your Critical Strikes with direct damage spells increase your chance to get a Critical Strike with melee attacks by 3% for 10 sec.

talents.name: Reverberation
talents.game_en: Reduces the cooldown of your Shock spells by 0.2 sec.
talents.site_en: Reduces the cooldown of your Shock spells by 0.2 sec.

talents.name: Elemental Alacrity
talents.game_en: Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 0.2 sec.
talents.site_en: Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 0.17 sec.

talents.name: Call of Flame
talents.game_en: Increases the damage done by your Fire Totems and by your Flame Shock and Fire Nova spells by 15%, as well as increases the duration of your Flame Shock spell by 9 sec.
talents.site_en: Increases the damage done by your Fire Totems and by your Flame Shock and Fire Nova spells by 5%, as well as increases the duration of your Flame Shock spell by 3 sec.

talents.name: Elemental Focus
talents.game_en: Gives you a 10% chance to enter a Clearcasting state after casting any Fire, Frost, or Nature damage spell. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.
talents.site_en: Gives you a 10% chance to enter a Clearcasting state after casting any Fire, Frost, or Nature damage spell. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

talents.name: Elemental Warding
talents.game_en: Reduces damage taken from Fire, Frost, and Nature effects by 4%.
talents.site_en: Reduces damage taken from Fire, Frost, and Nature effects by 3%.

talents.name: Trial by Fire
talents.game_en: Increases the damage done by your Fire Nova spell by 20% and reduces its cooldown by 2 sec, and increases the duration of your Magma Totem by 20 sec.
talents.site_en: Increases the damage done by your Fire Nova spell by 10% and reduces its cooldown by 2 sec, and increases the duration of your Magma Totem by 10 sec.

talents.name: Eye of the Storm
talents.game_en: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.
talents.site_en: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 23% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

talents.name: Earthbound
talents.game_en: Your Earthbind Totem Immobilizes nearby targets for 5 sec when cast.
talents.site_en: Your Earthbind Totem Immobilizes nearby targets for 5 sec when cast.

talents.name: Elemental Reach
talents.game_en: Increases the range of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Fire Nova spells by 6 yards.
talents.site_en: Increases the range of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Fire Nova, and Lava Burst spells by 3 yards and reduces the cooldown of Totemic Projection by 10 sec.

talents.name: Call of Thunder
talents.game_en: Increases the critical strike chance of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 5%.

talents.name: Lightning Overload
talents.game_en: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 30% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage and no threat.
talents.site_en: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 3% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage and no threat.

talents.name: Elemental Fury
talents.game_en: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by 100%.
talents.site_en: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by 20%.

talents.name: Lightning Mastery
talents.game_en: Gain mastery over Lightning, reducing the cast time of your Lightning Bolt spell by 0.5 sec, and removing the cooldown from your Chain Lightning spell. Lasts 15 sec.
talents.site_en: Gain mastery over Lightning, reducing the cast time of your Lightning Bolt spell by 0.5 sec, and removing the cooldown from your Chain Lightning spell. Lasts 15 sec.

talents.name: Earth's Grasp
talents.game_en: Increases the health of your Stoneclaw Totem by 25% and the radius of your Earthbind Totem by 10%.
talents.site_en: Increases the health of your Stoneclaw Totem by 25% and the radius of your Earthbind Totem by 10%.

talents.name: Thundering Strikes
talents.game_en: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 1%.
talents.site_en: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 1%.

talents.name: Ancestral Knowledge
talents.game_en: Increases your Intellect by 10%.
talents.site_en: Increases your Intellect by 2%.

talents.name: Guardian Totems
talents.game_en: Increases the amount of damage reduced by your Stoneskin Totem and Windwall Totem by 10% and reduces the cooldown of your Grounding Totem by 1 sec.
talents.site_en: Increases the amount of damage reduced by your Stoneskin Totem and Windwall Totem by 10% and reduces the cooldown of your Grounding Totem by 1 sec.

talents.name: Mental Dexterity
talents.game_en: Increases your Attack Power by an amount equal to 100% of your Intellect.
talents.site_en: Increases your Attack Power by an amount equal to 33% of your Intellect.

talents.name: Improved Lightning Shield
talents.game_en: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Shield orbs by 5%.
talents.site_en: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Shield orbs by 5%.

talents.name: Elemental Weapons
talents.game_en: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Rockbiter Weapon by 7%, your Windfury Weapon effect by 13% and increases the damage caused by your Flametongue Weapon and Frostbrand Weapon by 5%.
talents.site_en: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Rockbiter Weapon by 7%, your Windfury Weapon effect by 13% and increases the damage caused by your Flametongue Weapon and Frostbrand Weapon by 5%.

talents.name: Shamanistic Focus
talents.game_en: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock and Lightning Shield spells by 45%.
talents.site_en: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock and Lightning Shield spells by 45%.

talents.name: Anticipation
talents.game_en: Increases your chance to dodge by an additional 1%.
talents.site_en: Increases your chance to dodge by an additional 2%.

talents.name: Toughness
talents.game_en: Increases your Stamina by 2%.
talents.site_en: Increases your Stamina by 2%.

talents.name: Flurry
talents.game_en: Increases your attack speed by 1% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.
talents.site_en: Increases your attack speed by 5% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

talents.name: Stormstrike
talents.game_en: Instantly strike for 150% weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec.
talents.site_en: Instantly strike for 150% weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec.

talents.name: Improved Ghost Wolf
talents.game_en: Reduces the cast time of your Ghost Wolf spell by 3 sec, and Ghost Wolf may be used indoors.
talents.site_en: Reduces the cast time of your Ghost Wolf spell by 1.0 sec, and Ghost Wolf may be used indoors.

talents.name: Spirit Weapons
talents.game_en: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks, reduces all threat generated by your attacks by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is not active, and increases all threat generated by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is active.
talents.site_en: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks, reduces all threat generated by your attacks by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is not active, and increases all threat generated by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is active.

talents.name: Mental Quickness
talents.game_en: Increases your spell damage and healing by up to 30% of your Intellect.
talents.site_en: Increases your spell damage and healing by up to 15% of your Intellect.

talents.name: Improved Stormstrike
talents.game_en: When you Stormstrike, you have a 20% chance to gain 50% mana regeneration while casting spells for 15 sec, and Stormstrike's cooldown has a 20% chance to reset each time you Dodge or Parry.
talents.site_en: When you Stormstrike, you have a 50% chance to gain 50% mana regeneration while casting spells for 15 sec, and Stormstrike's cooldown has a 50% chance to reset each time you Dodge or Parry.

talents.name: Maelstrom Weapon
talents.game_en: When you deal damage with a melee attack, you have a chance to reduce the cast time and Mana cost of your next Lightning Bolt spell by 20%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.
talents.site_en: When you deal damage with a melee attack, you have a chance to reduce the cast time and Mana cost of your next Lightning Bolt spell by 4%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.

talents.name: Rage of the Farseer
talents.game_en: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 25 sec.
talents.site_en: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 25 sec.

talents.name: Improved Healing Wave
talents.game_en: Reduces the casting time of your Healing Wave spell by 0.1 sec.
talents.site_en: Reduces the casting time of your Healing Wave spell by 0.1 sec.

talents.name: Tidal Focus
talents.game_en: Reduces the Mana cost of your healing spells by 5% and improves your chance to hit by 5%.
talents.site_en: Reduces the Mana cost of your healing spells by 1% and improves your chance to hit by 1%.

talents.name: Mindfulness
talents.game_en: Allows 5% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.
talents.site_en: Allows 17% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.name: Natural Grace
talents.game_en: Reduces the threat generated by your spells by 30%.
talents.site_en: Reduces the threat generated by your spells by 5%.

talents.name: Totemic Focus
talents.game_en: Reduces the Mana cost of your totems and any spells that summon or move them by 5%.
talents.site_en: Reduces the Mana cost of your totems and any spells that summon or move them by 5%.

talents.name: Improved Reincarnation
talents.game_en: Reduces the cooldown of your Reincarnation spell by 10 min, increases your maximum health by 4%, and increases the amount of health and Mana you reincarnate with by an additional 10%.
talents.site_en: Reduces the cooldown of your Reincarnation spell by 10 min, increases your maximum health by 2%, and increases the amount of health and Mana you reincarnate with by an additional 10%.

talents.name: Ancestral Healing
talents.game_en: Increases your target's armor value by $m1% for 15 sec after getting a critical effect from one of your healing spells.
talents.site_en: Increases your target's armor value by 8% for 15 sec after getting a critical effect from one of your healing spells.

talents.name: Healing Focus
talents.game_en: Gives your healing spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.
talents.site_en: Gives your healing spells a 23% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

talents.name: Water Shield
talents.game_en:
The caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water. When a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's spells gets a critical result, 2% of maximum mana is restored to the caster, expending one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds. Lasts 10 min.

Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.
